meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.

copy.tagline: 打造有辨识度的界面视觉风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计新界面或优化现有视觉风格
copy.tagline_en: Craft distinctive visual styles for your UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing a new UI or refining an existing visual style

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像一位设计总监，帮你构思独特的视觉风格，包括配色、字体、布局，并确保设计不像是模板生成的。它会先制定设计计划，自我审查，再写代码。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 设计或修改网页界面，尤其是需要独特视觉风格时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个关于咖啡品牌的首页，要独特一点。
say.note: Claude 会先构思设计计划，再生成代码。

say.text: 这个页面看起来太模板化了，帮我重新设计。
say.note: Claude 会分析并替换掉常见的默认风格。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a design lead, helping you craft distinctive visual identities for UI projects. It plans a unique color palette, typography, and layout, self-critiques to avoid generic defaults, then writes code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to design or redesign a web interface, especially when you want a unique visual style.

say_en.text: Design a homepage for a coffee brand, make it unique.
say_en.note: Claude will first create a design plan, then generate code.

say_en.text: This page looks too templated, redesign it.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and replace generic defaults.
